recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-layered collage featuring two young female figures in a painterly, pop-art style. The composition is characterized by jagged, hand-cut edges, vibrant primary color blocks, and a mix of high-contrast portraiture and industrial, label-maker typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal division between red and yellow background fields
Juxtaposition of painterly portraits with rigid, mechanical text strips
Interaction between halftone dot patterns in the title and solid color fills in the figures
Layered depth created by overlapping 'cut-out' elements
coreInvariants: High-contrast, saturated color palette (Red, Yellow, Blue, Black)
Visible paper edges and 'cut-and-paste' assembly aesthetic
Monospaced white text on black rectangular strips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale portraits dominate the lower two-thirds, with the right figure slightly higher and more central.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized title in the upper left corner, angled upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal flow from top-left title, down through the figures' faces, to the horizontal text strips at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'packed' to reflect urban energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and Red background blocks provide high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black used for shadows, outlines, and text backgrounds to ground the composition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Magenta highlights within the painterly skin tones and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast in the facial features.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif and monospaced typewriter styles.
letterConstructionRules: Title uses thick, square-proportioned blocks with internal halftone dot gradients.
Secondary text uses uniform-width, slab-like characters reminiscent of early computer printouts or label makers.
Text strips have irregular, hand-cut ends.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title glyphs feature a 'stepped' or pixelated edge treatment.
Secondary text strips are slightly rotated to mimic manual application.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between large, textured display type and small, clean mechanical type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mechanical, label-maker aesthetic of the secondary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or custom block pixel font
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, urban weight of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage-style illustration of two young women with messy hair and urban clothing. Use a painterly style with visible brushstrokes and high-contrast lighting. The background should be split diagonally between bright red and yellow. Include jagged, hand-cut paper edges around the figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, blocky title in the top left corner with a black outline and a red-to-yellow halftone dot fill. Place multiple horizontal black strips across the bottom half containing white monospaced uppercase text, slightly staggered to look like hand-applied tape.

verificationChecks: Do the text strips look like physical tape?
Is the title font heavy and textured with dots?
Are the portraits high-contrast and painterly?

adjustableVariables: Density of the halftone dots in the title
Number and placement of the black text strips
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact artist names listed on the strips
Any specific studio or production logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is 'floating' without a black strip background.
Check that the halftone dots are visible in the title.
Verify the 'cut-out' jagged edges are present on the subjects.
Confirm the color palette is limited to primary-adjacent tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Painterly Urban Portraiture] + [Diagonal Primary Color Block Background] + [Halftone Block Display Type] + [Monospaced Text on Black Tape Strips] to create a [Punk/New Wave Collage Aesthetic].
